The size matters

An x² square, an x rod and a unit tile have different algebraic values. Only tiles of the same type can be combined.

Signs matter too

Positive tiles glow green. Negative tiles glow red with diagonal hatching. A positive and negative tile of the same type add to zero.

The size matters

An x² square, an x rod and a unit tile have different algebraic values. Only tiles of the same type can be combined.

Signs matter too

Positive tiles glow green. Negative tiles glow red with diagonal hatching. A positive and negative tile of the same type add to zero.

Algebra tile workshop
Square · rod · unit
Area · x²
Length · x

The size matters

An x² square, an x rod and a unit tile have different algebraic values. Only tiles of the same type can be combined.

Signs matter too

Positive tiles glow green. Negative tiles glow red with diagonal hatching. A positive and negative tile of the same type add to zero.

The size matters

An x² square, an x rod and a unit tile have different algebraic values. Only tiles of the same type can be combined.

Signs matter too

Positive tiles glow green. Negative tiles glow red with diagonal hatching. A positive and negative tile of the same type add to zero.

The size matters

An x² square, an x rod and a unit tile have different algebraic values. Only tiles of the same type can be combined.

Signs matter too

Positive tiles glow green. Negative tiles glow red with diagonal hatching. A positive and negative tile of the same type add to zero.

An x² square, an x rod and a unit tile have different algebraic values. Only tiles of the same type can be combined.

Signs matter too

Positive tiles glow green. Negative tiles glow red with diagonal hatching. A positive and negative tile of the same type add to zero.
